mapper.insert: insert into task (id, user_id, template_id, template_title, required_image_count, status, stage, stage_detail, result_url, fail_reason, created_at, updated_at) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{templateId}, #{templateTitle}, #{requiredImageCount}, #{status}, #{stage}, #{stageDetail}, #{resultUrl}, #{failReason}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: select * from task where user_id = #{userId} order by created_at desc
mapper.update: update task set status = #{status}, stage = #{stage}, stage_detail = #{stageDetail}, result_url = #{resultUrl}, fail_reason = #{failReason}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
